title: Hearts of Palm and Avocado Salad
description: Try this delicious hearts of palm salad with avocado, vegetables, and a simple lime dressing.
ingredients: 2 (14 ounce) cans whole hearts of palm, drained
1 serrano chile pepper, seeded and minced

steps.text: Peel the hearts of palm into strips lengthwise and cut the pile of strips in half. Set aside.
Combine lime juice and vinegar in a small bowl and whisk in olive oil to combine. Season with chili powder and salt and set aside.
Combine onion, bell pepper, radish, carrots, tomato, serrano, cilantro, and reserved vinaigrette in a medium bowl; stir to combine. Gently fold in avocado and hearts of palm. Serve immediately.

video.description: In this video, learn what you need to know about hearts of palm, a somewhat exotic ingredient that leaves many of us scratching our heads when it’s time to use it. Chef Nicole McLaughlin has the right tips, tricks, and hacks you should know if you want to take advantage of this versatile tropical ingredient. Hearts of palm have a subtle flavor that's reminiscent of artichoke hearts, white asparagus, and water chestnuts. The flesh is juicy with a bit of crunch — an ideal ingredient for a meat substitute. From salad to dip, we’ve got the recipes you need!
